description.value:
Activate 10 minutes

Recover a soul dead under 24 hours before any harvester claims it — as True Resurrection, calling the soul back into a fully repaired body. Costs 1 permanent Reckoning stage beyond your current maximum, paid regardless, which never resets and stacks on repeated use.

target.value: 1 creature dead no more than 24 hours, soul unclaimed

cinderfall.incomplete: The 1 permanent Reckoning stage beyond current maximum the true-resurrection-equivalent costs -- the Reckoning (this class's own 4-stage penalty track) has zero Foundry-schema footprint: classes.reckoner.json ships "rules": [] and defines no SpecialResource, counter, or stage-tracking rule element of any kind to hook. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md (RECKONING-BLOCKER).
